preconditions.description: The length of the binary string t must be between 1 and 200,000.
The length of the string t must match the specified length n.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l1 <= n and 1 <= l2 <= n and 1 <= length <= n - max(l1, l2) + 1 for l1, l2, length in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid indices and length within the bounds of the string t.

postconditions.description: The output for each query must be either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all((t[l1-1:l1+length-1] == t[l2-1:l2+length-1]) or (t[l1-1:l1+length-1] == t[l2-1:l2+length-1].replace('011', '110').replace('110', '011')) for l1, l2, length in queries)
postconditions.description: For each query, the output must reflect whether the substring from l1 is reachable from the substring from l2.
